product_metadata.title: ONTEL BE-MC2 Breathe Easy Humidifier Ultra Cool Mist with Whisper Quiet Operation, Filtration, Auto off Timer, 1.2 Gallon Water Tank and Adjustable Nozzle, As Seen on TV
features: BREATHE EASY HUMIDIFIER eliminates the dry air that can irritate and inflame the passages of your nose and throat. No more dry scratchy eyes, nose and throat!
COOL MIST TECHNOLOGY provides the much needed moisture to your home, for comfortable breathing. Perfect for relieving the discomfort of cold, flu, and dry weather!
EASY TO READ digital led display includes five mist settings, adjustable humidistat & auto off timer
EASY TO USE top-fill design conveniently refills the tank without having to remove it! No more lugging a gallon tank to and from the sink! You can easily pour water in while the unit stays in place!
RUNS UP TO 60 HOURS on Just ONE Fill! The tank and base are made with an inhibitor to prevent any unhealthy build-up. The permanent ceramic filter never needs to be replaced!
